confidential-ledger-managed-ccf-deprecat.title: Managed CCF is being deprecated; use a standard confidential ledger for new work
confidential-ledger-managed-ccf-deprecat.body: This estimate uses Managed CCF, which Microsoft is deprecating and will no longer update or support. For a new design, price a standard Azure confidential ledger instead, and plan a migration if a Managed CCF network already exists.

citation.source: Migrating from Azure Managed CCF to Azure confidential ledger
citation.quote: Managed CCF) is being deprecated and will no longer receive updates or support.
